assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create an original environmental matte painting for BibleMap, wide landscape 3:2. First-century Galilean hill-country village, evocative painted film background, mineral pigments, deep blue-gray shadows and sunlit pale limestone, soft muted olive green, dusty rose distant hills. View from an irregular limestone doorway/terrace looking across a small inhabited village toward rounded Galilean hills. Modest one-storey rough limestone houses, flat roofs, a courtyard, stone cistern opening, a few very small anonymous people in plain undyed clothing far away for human scale, no recognizable face. Strong physical depth: close shadowed left wall and olive tree, middle sunlit courtyard and rooftops, distant rolling hills with atmospheric haze. This is deliberately interpretive art, NOT an archaeological reconstruction of an identified dwelling, NOT a likeness of James or Jesus, no biblical episode, no interaction claimed from history. Archaeological reference constraints: Israel Antiquities Authority Yardenna Alexandre Nazareth dwelling publication Atiqot 98 reports late Hellenistic/Early Roman domestic remains and subterranean pits/silos; use general limestone domestic environment only. No medieval domes, no churches, no crosses, no modern objects, no grand Roman colonnades, no visible text, no scroll or paper shapes, no image border. Cinematic generous environment, quiet ordinary life. Upper third broad atmospheric hills/sky suitable for separate overlaid website title. assets.prompt: Use case historical-scene. Original painterly environmental matte painting for BibleMap website, wide landscape 3:2, physical depth and ordinary human life in an interpreted first-century Jerusalem setting. View from inside a shadowed limestone domestic threshold down stepped narrow lanes across dense irregular flat-roofed pale limestone dwellings and courtyards toward the monumental elevated Temple precinct in far distance, dusty Judean hills beyond. Near foreground dark blue-gray stone doorway at right, middle scene inhabited warm limestone street with a handful of very small anonymous people in simple undyed garments, no identifiable faces or biblical characters, no staged specific historical event. Late afternoon shafts of sunlight through dusty air, restrained rose limestone and mineral ochre highlights, charcoal and indigo shadows, pale desaturated sky. Hand-painted gouache/oil texture coherent with a quiet Galilean village painting. Historical reference constraints: IAA Hagbi/Uziel Western Wall Foundations report 2015 supports first-century stone courses, street-retaining walls and elevation near southwest Temple Mount; Israel Museum Jerusalem model represents 66 CE and supplies only broad contrast of monumental precinct and domestic roofs, NOT exact setting of James's community. All detailed layout imagined. Temple far away simple rectilinear precinct and sanctuary, NO modern golden Dome of the Rock, no domes, minarets, church, crosses or modern objects. NO cactus or New World plants. Do not reproduce archaeological model or existing artwork. No scrolls, paper, words, pseudo-Hebrew, labels or borders. Strong horizontal composition with city and lived street filling most of image; do not leave generic empty sky. Express environment, not a reenactment or authenticated reconstruction.
